name: swarm-kit
description: Swarm orchestration kit: scout/worker/judge agent types, a .swarm/ blackboard protocol, an L1-L4 graded orchestration playbook, and a retrospective skill for self-improvement.

interface.longDescription: Swarm Kit packages 2024-2026 multi-agent research (orchestrator-worker, routines and handoffs, sampling-and-voting, optimizable agent graphs) into a practical playbook: three worker agent types (scout/worker/judge), a blackboard protocol under .swarm/, an orchestration skill with L1-L4 effort scaling, and a retrospective skill that improves the swarm's own prompts.
